message.content:
This is an upholstered armchair with a wooden frame, so it falls in heading 9401. It is not a swivel chair and not a reclining chair, which points to the "other seats, with wooden frames" provision in 9401.61 (upholstered).

HTSUS 9401.61.40 covers "Other seats, with wooden frames: Upholstered: Other" and has the following breakouts: 9401.61.40 (Other) → 9401.61.4011 (Dining chairs / other?). I recall the 9401.61.60 provision is "Other" and 9401.61.40 is "Seats of a kind used in motor vehicles"? That is not right either. The actual structure is:
- 9401.61.20: Seats of the type used for... (nonvehicle?)
- 9401.61.40: Other: Chairs... 
- 9401.61.60: Other.

CBP rulings for upholstered wooden-frame armchairs usually classify them under 9401.61.6011 (Other seats, with wooden frames, upholstered, other, "Other"). In practice, 9401.61.6011 is used for "Other: Household" items, and 9401.61.4011 is for "Stackable" or similar items. I will go with 9401.61.6011.

